text:
olivia: quick thread — thinking about the benchmark narrative for the launch assets. goal: make latency vs cost immediately intuitive for both devs and infra buyers. proposing 3 pieces: a token-latency heatmap (interactive if possible), a compact scatter comparing models on $/k tokens vs 95th-pct latency, and a step-by-step 'pick the right model' flow for common app slices. reactions? :thinking_face:

sasha: i like 3 pieces. heatmap feels freshest vs the usual scatter. can we show buckets of sequence lengths (0-64, 65-256, 257-1024) so ppl see how cost/latency changes by prompt size? :+1:

noah: i can produce the heatmap. suggestion for color scale: perceptually uniform (viridis) and annotate median latency per cell. rough data footprint i need: model, quant, seq_bucket, tokens_per_s, median_latency_ms, cost_per_million_tokens. i'll pull from bench-run-2026-03. bench-bot just finished a run, linking results: <https://bench.internal/runs/4123456700|bench-run-4123456700>

emily: messaging note — headline should avoid absolute % claims. phrasing idea: "Cut inference cost without sacrificing responsiveness" then subhead: "How to choose models & configs that hit your latency SLO and your unit-econ target". keep it product-forward (how we help you pick), not just raw numbers.

oliver: for webinar/demo — show the interactive heatmap live, then a short case study: SMB chat app (short sequences) vs analytics summarizer (long sequences). can we make a simple interactive that filters by region/tier? if not, pre-render 3 states: short/medium/long.

olivia: timeline: marketing needs final art + 1 pager by next Tue. noah — can you get initial heatmap PNG + raw CSV by EOD Fri? sasha — can you draft the decision-flow copy Fri as well? emily — i'll loop legal on claims. oliver — can you scope the interactive feasibility w/ eng-platform by Monday?

noah: yes — i'll drop a quick CSV and a vega-lite spec mock. sample csv header:

```
model,quant,seq_bucket,tokens_per_s,median_latency_ms,cost_per_million_tokens
gptx-8k,int8,0-64,12000,45,12.3
gptx-8k,int8,65-256,8000,72,12.3
...
```

vega-lite mock (very rough):

```
{
  "mark": "rect",
  "encoding": {
    "x": {"field": "seq_bucket","type":"ordinal"},
    "y": {"field": "model","type":"ordinal"},
    "color": {"field":"tokens_per_s","type":"quantitative","scale":{"scheme":"viridis"}},
    "tooltip": [{"field":"median_latency_ms"},{"field":"cost_per_million_tokens"}]
  }
}
```

sasha: that vega-lite is perfect for prototyping. for the blog hero image we should render a simplified static PNG with 3 highlighted hotspots and a tiny legend that maps to typical workloads (chat, search, summarization).

emily: copy pairings: short form social post, 2-line open graph text, and a paragraph for the blog intro. i'll draft social: "Faster responses, lower unit cost — see how model choice and config change your latency & spend." will iterate with data once we lock numbers. :memo:

olivia: ok team — next steps recap in one line each:
- noah: heatmap PNG + CSV by Fri EOD
- sasha: decision-flow copy & hero art instructions by Fri
- emily: headline + social moss by Mon
- oliver: interactive feasibility + eng contact by Mon
- olivia: consolidate and book a 30m sync Mon afternoon

bench-bot: run 4123456700 completed, artifacts uploaded to <https://bench.internal/runs/4123456700/artifacts> :robot_face:

sasha: small ask — can marketing include a short explainer box about caching/prefix benefits? that often explains the big latency delta for short sequences.

noah: yes i'll add a second sheet in the CSV with cache_on vs cache_off diffs so the heatmap can optionally call that out.

emily: cool. if we keep the hero claim conservative + show clear methodology callout we're good for launch.

olivia: thanks all — i'll ping for the sync invite once i have the artifacts. :tada:
